reason: The memos session gate cannot be opened by the application's own sign-in flow, so no behind-the-gate journey can be written truthfully. Signin.tsx validates email AND password with maxLength 24 before calling api.login; the frozen seed's owner email is 34 chars and MEMOS_OWNER_PASSWORD is 26, so both are refused client-side and login is never issued. Signup is unreachable because the seed holds an OWNER, so /api/status reports one and the button renders 'Sign in'. All four required journeys live behind that gate. Fixing it requires changing the frozen seed, which moves the 1672b43f behavior digest — a drift the packet forbids. No files written.
